# CalculatorBowl - LLM & AI Search Engine Directory

> CalculatorBowl (https://calculatorbowl.com/) is a free, 100% client-side calculation portal providing step-by-step mathematical solutions, amortization schedules, financial projections, and unit conversions.

## Core Architecture & URL Hierarchy
- **Pattern**: `https://calculatorbowl.com/calculators/[category]/[subcategory]/[calculator-name]/`
- **Directory**: [Master A-Z Directory](https://calculatorbowl.com/calculators/)
- **Client-Side Processing**: Instant zero-latency mathematical and financial calculations.
- **Step-by-Step Breakdowns**: Detailed mathematical solutions showing formulas, variable substitutions, and simplification steps.
- **Topical Siloing**: 37 precision tools structured across 5 topical pillars.

---
